subject: Re: Agile Modeling status: end-to-end flow live, alpha metric needed
body:
Vera, Alina,

Post-precompute decisions. The embedding run over the unlabeled pool finished on Cirrus during our reserved week, so the pool is live — nice execution.

Scope call for the alpha: we go with six concepts, not fourteen. The other eight stay in the regression eval, but the alpha UX only ships the six with mean AP above 0.78. Time-to-first-classifier target stays under 30 minutes.

Linnea owns the alpha build, Maren keeps the pool refresh weekly. Alpha demo for Hana's staff the week of Aug 3, which keeps us inside the window with margin.

Dmitri
